<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'parsed data'>">
  %ent;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns/base" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/ns/sub">
  <!-- Main entry point comment covering structure -->
  <sub:child id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw CDATA text with <tags> & entities like &internal;
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>
```

<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base-ent "Standard Value">
  <!ENTITY complex-ent "&base-ent; and More">
  <!ENTITY % param-ent "<!ENTITY nested-ent 'Nested Value'>">
  %param-ent;
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction target="validator" status="active"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://schema.example.com/catalog" xmlns:x="http://schema.example.com/catalog/x">
  <!-- Comment explaining item structure -->
  <x:item code="A1">
    <![CDATA[
      <x:item>CDATA section containing <markup> and &complex-ent;</x:item>
    ]]>
  </x:item>
  <item>&nested-ent;</item>
</catalog>

</doc>

  <arc:record id="rec-01">
    <?arc-action type="index"?>

      Archive CDATA payload containing <xml-fragment> &macro-ent;</xml-fragment>
    ]]>
  </arc:record>
  <record>&macro-ent;</record>
</archive>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item)*>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY item-name "Default Item">
  <!ENTITY % entity-set "<!ENTITY item-desc 'Detailed description of &item-name;'>">
  %entity-set;

  <!ENTITY sample-tiff "sample.tiff" NDATA tiff>
]>
<?xml-log level="debug" target="sysout"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/ns" xmlns:inv="http://inventory.org/ns/inv">
  <!-- Inventory header comment -->
  <inv:item id="i1">
    <?inv-processor mode="strict"?>
    <![CDATA[
      <!-- CDATA comment-like structure inside inventory -->
      &item-desc;
    ]]>
  </inv:item>
  <item>&item-desc;</item>
</inventory>
```

  <!ELEMENT document (element)*>
  <!ELEMENT element (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ref-a "Reference A">
  <!ENTITY ref-b "Reference B &ref-a;">

]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="default.css" type="text/css"?>
<document xmlns="http://document.org/ns" xmlns:ns="http://document.org/ns/ext">
  <!-- Comprehensive test comment for namespace and entity handling -->
  <ns:element id="el-1">
    <?ns-action type="validate"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block enclosing entity reference &ref-b; and &internal-param;
    ]]>
  </ns:element>
  <element>&ref-b;</element>
</document>

]>

    ]]>
  </pr:task>
  <task>&task-name;</task>
</project>

    ]]>

</workspace>
